data.one_liner: Pure Dart library for encoding and decoding QR codes.
data.what_it_does: Provides QR‑code encoding and decoding using only Dart code. Works with image byte data and returns text results. Currently limited to QR format only.
use_when: You need QR‑code generation or reading in a pure‑Dart/Flutter project without native plugins.
You target multiple platforms (mobile, web, desktop) and want a single dependency.
avoid_when: You require other barcode formats (EAN, Code128, etc.).
You need high‑performance real‑time scanning from a camera stream.
strengths: Pure Dart – no native setup or permissions required.
Supports both encoding and decoding of QR codes.
weaknesses: Performance may be lower than native scanner libraries.
No built‑in camera UI – you must integrate a camera plugin yourself.

alternatives.name: qr
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple QR‑code generation with no decoding, pure Dart.

alternatives.name: flutter_zxing
alternatives.why_pick_it: Similar barcode processing with broader format support.
